To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the synthesis of the organicinorganic polyoxometallates [PM11O3{9{Sn(C6 H4)C[double bond, length as prod]C(C6 H4 )N2}]3 (M = Mo,W) endowed with a terminal diazonium function was achieved and their immobilization onto hydrogen-terminated n-Si(1 00) was performed.
the synthesis of polyoxometallate hybrids endowed with a remote functional group has been achieved.
the polyoxometalato (POM) hybrid molecules [PM11O391 {Sn(C6H5)C≡C(C6H5)(N2)]3- (M=W, Mo) have been covalently attached on n-Si(1 0 0) substrates.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new class of molecular junctions based on polyoxometalato-bridged organic-inorganic hybrid molecules.
the development of new molecular materials for molecular electronics, and the understanding of the relationship between their molecular and electronic structures and their electrical properties.
the synthesis of organic-inorganic polymeric hybrids with a remote diazoniumpolyoxometalate function.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the POMs are good candidates for the design and fabrication of molecular memories, but further studies are needed for a more detailed analysis of the molecular signatures in electron transport.
the POM-based SMM junctions have been successfully fabricated and that the electrical properties of the resulting junctions can be related to the electronic properties of the POM building blocks.
the POMs are not only efficient electron reservoirs in solution, but also in the solid-state.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the POMs can be used as a molecular switch for memory devices.
the molecular signature of the polyoxometalatic molecules is clearly identifiable in the electrical properties and that the unmatched diversity of the POM structures offers a great modularity.
the molecular signature of the polyoxometalato ligands can be identified in the solid-state electronic properties of the resulting SMM junctions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
POMs can be integrated into molecular junctions and their electronic properties can be probed by electrical measurements.
the POMs are a new class of molecules with a great modularity and a great potential for the design of new functional molecular materials.
POMs are promising building blocks for molecular electronics.
